summary: Iteration 3 regression test after code-review refactor (evaluate_bot -> _decide_*/_bot_buy/_bot_sell helpers; backtest -> _bt_decide/_bt_build_curve helpers; hoisted random/json/re imports; React key fixes on Landing/Signals/Wallet; logout warning-on-failure). All 43/43 pytest tests pass (29 in backend_test.py + 14 in test_iteration2.py) in 8.46s. Frontend smoke test against external URL: login with seed creds (degen@memetrade.io / MemeMoon2026!) -> /dashboard works, Landing/Signals/Wallet/Bots routes render cleanly with ZERO React 'two children with the same key' or 'each child should have a unique key' warnings, logout-btn click redirects to /login successfully. console.warn for logout only fires on failure path (verified silent on happy path = expected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 985 lines (was ~950) - past the 700-line guideline. The new _decide_*/_bot_buy/_bot_sell/_bt_decide/_bt_build_curve helpers are well-scoped and each <30 LOC, but the file would benefit from splitting into routers/ (auth, coins, trades, bots, ai, swap, settings, backtest) - same comment carried from iteration 2.

Refactor preserves behaviour cleanly: evaluate_bot now reads as a strategy-dispatch + buy/sell action separation; _bt_decide mirrors the same dispatch shape for backtest -> good DRY between live bot and backtest paths. Consider extracting the strategy enum to a single source of truth (currently duplicated: evaluate_bot dispatch and _bt_decide dispatch).

Composite React keys on Landing.jsx ticker (${c.id}-${i}), Signals.jsx (coin_id-timestamp fallback to sig-${i}), Wallet.jsx (p.url fallback to symbol-chain-${i}) are correct - duplicates in c.id (multi-chain duplicate symbol) or repeated signal coin_ids are now safely keyed.

auth.jsx logout: catch-only-warn + always-clear-local-state pattern is the right UX (network failure shouldn't trap user in logged-in UI). Verified happy-path is silent in console; failure path will produce single console.warn without bricking UI.
Hoisting random/json/re to module-top is correct; no circular import risk seen. random is now used in _decide_ai (heuristic confidence) and dispatch_webhook backoff jitter.

Pre-existing dev-mode console.error from Emergent's editor instrumentation injecting <span style='display:contents'> inside <option> in Signals.jsx -> 'In HTML, %s cannot be a child of %s'. NOT caused by this refactor and not visible in production builds. Optional: ignore or move the static-imported coin list out of <option> children to silence.
Backtest endpoint shape verified for all 4 strategies (momentum/dca/stop_loss_take_profit/ai_signal): pnl_usd, pnl_pct, trade_count, equity_curve, trades all present and correctly typed.
